title: Longevity Translation Ledger
subtitle: Flagship anti-aging interventions: mouse evidence vs proven human hard-endpoint benefit. A living calibrated prior - updated as trials report.
method: Population = flagship interventions (NIA ITP positives + the most-hyped non-ITP). 'Proven human' requires a hard clinical endpoint (lifespan/healthspan) in a controlled human trial, not a biomarker/surrogate. Sources in each row.

status_legend.proven: Proven human benefit on a hard clinical endpoint
status_legend.failed: Tested in humans and did NOT translate
status_legend.null_or_safety: Human trial reported - safety/biomarker/null only, no hard-endpoint win
status_legend.pending: Human trial designed or in progress, no hard-endpoint result yet
status_legend.no_human_outcome: No meaningful human outcome data (mouse/cell-only or observational-only)

interventions.name: Rapamycin
interventions.human: PEARL RCT = safety only; gerotherapeutic efficacy unproven

interventions.name: Acarbose
interventions.human: Approved diabetes drug; observational only, no longevity RCT

interventions.name: Canagliflozin
interventions.human: Approved diabetes drug; no longevity RCT

interventions.name: Captopril
interventions.mouse: +4-5% female; male signal confounded by one site

interventions.name: Aspirin
interventions.human: ASPREE RCT: NO healthy-lifespan benefit in elderly, slight mortality increase

interventions.name: Metformin
interventions.mouse: NULL for lifespan in the ITP; healthspan signals elsewhere
interventions.human: TAME trial designed, unreported; observational mixed

interventions.name: Caloric restriction
interventions.mouse: Robust in rodents; primates SPLIT (UW yes / NIA no)
interventions.human: CALERIE 2yr: biomarker gains, NO lifespan endpoint

interventions.name: Senolytics (D+Q, fisetin)
interventions.human: Phase-1 pilots null (5-pt Alzheimer's 'no effectiveness'; STAMINA null)

interventions.name: NMN / NAD+ precursors
interventions.human: RCT meta-analyses NULL (muscle, metabolism); blood NAD+ doesn't track age

interventions.name: Resveratrol
interventions.human: Human trials null on the longevity claims

interventions.name: Partial reprogramming (OSK)
interventions.human: Human CELLS in vitro only; no human in-vivo outcome

interventions.name: Young plasma / GDF11 / parabiosis
interventions.mouse: Robust mouse parabiosis; GDF11 contested even in mice
interventions.human: Early Phase-1 (GDF11/stroke); small plasma RCTs; no longevity endpoint
